panels.title: Link
panels.description: HEARTBEAT from PX4 within the last 3 s (bridge) and a message within 5 s (dashboard).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  -- no message for 5 s (bridge / PX4 gone) = offline
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, CASE WHEN time < now() - interval '5 seconds' THEN 0 ELSE online END AS value
  FROM "online"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND online IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, armed AS value
  FROM "status"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND armed IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT drone, value FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, mode AS value
  FROM "status"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND mode IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY length(drone), drone

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: SYS_STATUS battery_remaining. SITL: PX4 battery_simulator (SIM_BAT_DRAIN, SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, pct AS value
  FROM "battery"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND pct IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, alt_rel AS value
  FROM "position"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 minute' AND alt_rel IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, sats AS value
  FROM "gps"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND sats IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

panels.title: Position and flight path
panels.description: Track = time range, big dot = last position. Same GPS as QGC (Baylands world origin).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), drone::int AS drone, last(lat, time) AS lat, last(lon, time) AS lon
FROM "position"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND lat IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, drone
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, lat, lon, alt_rel, drone::int AS drone
FROM "position"
WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND lat IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC

panels.title: Drone camera — drone ${camdrone}

targets.rawSql:

FROM "position"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND alt_rel IS NOT NULL

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), 'drone ' || drone AS drone, avg(climb) AS value

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), 'drone ' || drone AS drone, last(mode, time) AS mode

panels.title: Sensors
panels.description: SYS_STATUS: every enabled sensor healthy (gyro, accel, mag, baro, GPS, ...).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, all_ok AS value
  FROM "health"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND all_ok IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, load AS value
  FROM "health"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND load IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, fix_type AS value
  FROM "gps"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND fix_type IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY time

SELECT drone, value FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (drone::int) time, 'drone ' || drone AS drone, CASE WHEN total > 0 THEN (seq::int + 1) || ' / ' || total::int ELSE '-' END AS value
  FROM "mission"
  WHERE fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) AND time > now() - interval '1 day' AND seq IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY drone::int, time DESC
) s ORDER BY length(drone), drone

SELECT time AS "Time", 'drone ' || drone AS "Drone", severity::int AS "Severity", "text" AS "Message"
FROM "event"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), 'drone ' || drone || ' roll' AS drone, avg(roll) AS value
FROM "attitude" WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) GROUP BY 1, drone
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), 'drone ' || drone || ' pitch' AS drone, avg(pitch) AS value
FROM "attitude" WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fleet = '$fleet' AND drone IN ($drone) GROUP BY 1, drone
ORDER BY 1
